back_translation: Concerning the Ammonites, this is what the LORD says: Has Israel no sons? Has he no heir? Why then has Milcom taken possession of Gad, and his people settled in its cities?

Therefore behold, the days are coming, declares the LORD, when I will sound the battle cry against Rabbah of the Ammonites; it will become a desolate mound, and its villages will be burned with fire; then Israel will dispossess those who dispossessed him, says the LORD.

Wail, O Heshbon, for Ai is destroyed; cry out, O daughters of Rabbah; gird yourselves with sackcloth, lament, and run about within the folds, for Milcom will go into exile, his priests and his officials together.
Why do you boast in your valleys, your flowing valley, O faithless daughter, who trusts in her treasures, saying, Who can come against me?
Behold, I am about to bring terror upon you, declares the Lord GOD of Hosts, from all those around you; you will each be driven headlong, with no one to regather the fugitive.
Yet afterward I will restore the fortunes of the Ammonites, declares the LORD.
Concerning Edom, this is what the LORD of Hosts says: Is there no longer wisdom in Teman? Has counsel perished from the prudent? Has their wisdom rotted away?
Flee, turn back, lie low to dwell, O inhabitants of Dedan, for I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him at the time I punish him.
If grape gatherers came to you, would they not leave gleanings? If thieves came by night, would they not destroy only enough for themselves?
But I have stripped Esau bare; I have uncovered his hiding places, and he cannot conceal himself; his offspring is destroyed, with his brothers and his neighbors, and he is no more.
Leave your orphans; I will keep them alive; and let your widows trust in me.
For this is what the LORD says: Behold, those who did not deserve to drink the cup must surely drink it; and shall you go entirely unpunished? You will not go unpunished, but you must surely drink.
For I have sworn by myself, declares the LORD, that Bozrah will become a horror, a disgrace, a ruin, and a curse, and all her cities will be perpetual ruins.
I have heard a message from the LORD, and an envoy has been sent among the nations: Assemble and come against her, and rise up for battle.
For behold, I will make you small among the nations, despised among men.

The terror you cause and the pride of your heart have deceived you, O you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, who hold the height of the hill. Though you raise your nest high like the eagle, from there I will bring you down, declares the LORD.
And Edom will become a horror; everyone who passes by it will be appalled and will hiss at all its wounds.
As with the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and their neighbors, says the LORD, no one will dwell there, and no man will sojourn in it.

Behold, one will come up like a lion from the thickets of the Jordan to the perennial pasture; for in an instant I will chase Edom from it, and I will appoint over it whoever is chosen; for who is like me, and who can summon me, and what shepherd can stand before me?

Therefore hear the counsel of the LORD that he has planned against Edom, and the plans he has devised against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely the little ones of the flock will be dragged off; surely their pasture will be made desolate over them.
At the sound of their fall the earth quakes; the sound of their cry is heard at the Red Sea.
Behold, the enemy will mount up and swoop down like an eagle, spreading his wings over Bozrah; and in that day the heart of Edom's warriors will be like the heart of a woman in labor.
Concerning Damascus: Hamath and Arpad are put to shame, for they have heard bad news; they melt away; there is anxiety like the sea, which cannot be calmed.
Damascus has grown feeble; she has turned to flee, and panic has seized her; anguish and pangs have gripped her like a woman in labor.
How is the city of praise not forsaken, the town of my joy!
Therefore her young men will fall in her streets, and all her warriors will be silenced in that day, declares the LORD of Hosts.
And I will set fire to the wall of Damascus, and it will consume the palaces of Ben-hadad.
Concerning Kedar and the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon defeated, this is what the LORD says: Rise up, advance against Kedar, and destroy the people of the east.
Their tents and their flocks will be taken; their tent curtains and all their goods and their camels will be carried off for themselves; and they will shout to them, Terror on every side!
Flee, escape quickly, lie low to dwell, O inhabitants of Hazor, declares the LORD, for Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has drawn up a plan against you and devised a scheme against you.
Rise up, advance against a nation at ease, that dwells securely, declares the LORD; it has no gates and no bars; they dwell alone.

Their camels will become plunder, and their many herds a spoil; and I will scatter to every wind those who clip the corners of their hair, and from every side I will bring their calamity, declares the LORD.
And Hazor will become a haunt of jackals, a desolation forever; no one will dwell there, and no man will sojourn in it.
The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning Elam, at the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying:
This is what the LORD of Hosts says: Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the mainstay of their might.

And I will bring against Elam the four winds from the four corners of the heavens, and I will scatter them to all those winds; and there will not be a nation to which the exiles of Elam will not come.

And I will terrify Elam before their enemies and before those who seek their lives, and I will bring disaster upon them, my fierce anger, declares the LORD; and I will send the sword after them until I have consumed them.
And I will set my throne in Elam, and I will destroy from there king and officials, declares the LORD.
Yet in the latter days I will restore the fortunes of Elam, declares the LORD.
